intro: Your friend Josh has invited you out for a weekend retreat at his family's cabin. Get ready for fun and adventure.
afterPacking: Time to meet at Tyler's. He's driving us all in his short bus.
busBreakdown: Halfway up the mountain road, Tyler's short bus lets out a loud bang, shudders, and rolls to a stop in a cloud of smoke. Tyler pops the hood, stares at the engine for a long moment, and announces that it isn't fixable.

There's no cell service and the sun is already sinking. Josh's cabin is a few miles away through the woods, so there's only one option: grab your bag and start walking. Whatever you packed is all you've got.

events.title: Strange Noises
events.description: You hear strange animal noises nearby. Seems like it's coming from that bush over there, or maybe that one.
events.successText: You toss it into the distance, hopefully distracting whatever was out there. Seems like it worked. Let's move on.
events.failText: That wasn't useful. The strange animal jumps out of the bushes and knocks you over as it darts away. You lose 1 energy.
events.doNothingText: You do nothing and lose 1 energy.

events.title: Wild Twink
events.description: You see a wild twink nearby. What's he doing out here?
events.successText: The twink looks gleeful. He says he's waiting for his date out here and these poppers will definitely come in handy. His attention turns back to the forest. Let's move on.
events.failText: "I don't need that! I need someone to use me. And you'll have to do." The twink's energy seems endless; yours is not. You lose 1 energy.
events.doNothingText: You do nothing and lose 1 energy.

events.description: The path forward looks unstable, but we need to push through.
events.successText: Your choice was useful and you move on.
events.failText: That wasn't useful. You lose 1 energy.
events.doNothingText: You do nothing and lose 1 energy.

events.title: A Helpful Stranger
events.description: You come across a man named Lowe. He says he's certain he knows the way and that you should come with him, but you're not sure you trust that shimmer in his pale green eyes.
events.successText: You page through the book, getting momentarily caught up in the plot. But you read enough to know that he is a werewolf who only wants ONE thing, and it isn't to help you. You tell him no thanks and carry on.
events.failText: He asks, "What's that for?" You're not certain either, and you end up following him deeper into the woods. A bit of moonlight lands on Lowe, and you notice he's much hairier than before. You try to turn back, but it's too late. In full werewolf mode, he pounces on you, eyes full of lust. You don't have time to say no, but you aren't sure you would have. Tired and sexually conflicted, you move on. You lose 1 energy.
events.doNothingText: You do nothing and lose 1 energy.

events.title: Sheer Terror
events.description: You feel like the cabin is too far away and that you will never make it. You're going to freeze to death out in these woods, and you know it.
events.successText: Oops, I was being a bit dramatic. The cabin probably isn't much farther. I should keep moving.
events.failText: That wasn't useful. You struggle under the anxiety and mental fatigue, but you manage to find your way again. You lose 1 energy.
events.doNothingText: You do nothing and lose 1 energy.

events.title: Intense Thirst
